articles.title: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch
articles.description: Sega is removing Total War: Shogun 2 - Complete Edition from storefronts following a disastrous launch where users complained about issues like bugs and upscaling that appears to have been done by AI.
